title: setblock
description: Changes a block to another block.

position.title: position
position.description: A `vector` [x y z] that defines the position of the block to change.

tilename.title: tileName
tilename.description: An block name from the `enum` that specifies the new block.

blockstates.title: blockStates
blockstates.description: The block states from the `enum` to use for the block to be set.
